title: A Big Country
text:
Brazil is a big country in South America. It has a long river called the Amazon. The Amazon is in the north of the country. Many trees grow near the river.

The south of Brazil has big cities and mountains. Some mountains are cold in winter. People visit the beaches on the east coast. The beaches are very beautiful.

questions.text: What is the name of the long river in Brazil?
Where are the big cities in Brazil?
Why do people visit the beaches?
options: To enjoy the sea and the sun

questions.text: What is probably true about the area near the Amazon?
options: It is on the east coast

vocabulary.definition: a large natural stream of water that flows into a sea or lake
very high areas of land, higher than hills
areas of sand or small stones next to the sea
tall plants with a trunk, branches and leaves

paragraph_translations: O Brasil é um país grande na América do Sul. Tem um rio longo chamado Amazonas. O Amazonas fica no norte do país. Muitas árvores crescem perto do rio.
O sul do Brasil tem cidades grandes e montanhas. Algumas montanhas são frias no inverno. As pessoas visitam as praias na costa leste. As praias são muito bonitas.
